title: Freightliner Argosy Fups high tensile polished aluminium Bullbar #2
description: Freightliner Argosy hi-tensile aluminium FUPS bullbar, driving light mounts to suit application, Indicator repeater light to main channel. Air flow provision to main channel to ensure maximum air flow to radiator. Fixed load signs with covers, reversable aluminium load signs are optional. Heavy duty steel backing plate.
